We're seeking motivated individuals - people that are interested in developing a long-term career in the security field.

jobs.title: Hospitality Security Supervisor-Chicago Nightlife
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

AG Security Group Inc. has been the leader in nightlife, hospitality and event security in Chicago for over 10 years. AG Security provides high quality, professional security officers to all industries including but not limited to Nightclubs, Bars, Lounges, Restaurants, Schools, Retail Stores, Commercial and Residential Buildings, Executive Protection, and Special Events. Our absolute commitment to client satisfaction, attention to detail, superior customer service, and unparalleled personnel is what separates us from our competitors.

Your Mission:

As a Security Supervisor, you are responsible for overseeing security operations at assigned venues, ensuring the safety of guests, staff, and property. You will lead a team of security officers, manage crowd control, coordinate event security, and serve as the primary point of contact between venue management and the security team. You will be responsible for maintaining a professional and secure environment while delivering a high level of customer service in fast paced nightlife and hospitality settings.

Job Responsibilities:

To help you understand your role in working for a world class organization, the following is a list of your job responsibilities. Please keep in mind that this list is not all inclusive and that you may be asked to perform other job tasks as needed to keep up with the changing world and ensuring the best customer service experience for our clients:

  • Supervise and direct on-site security officers during assigned shifts
  • Manage crowd control and ensure safe capacity levels at all times
  • Monitor entry points, check identification, and enforce venue admission policies
  • Protect VIP sections, entertainers, and special guests
  • Coordinate security operations during major events and high volume nights
  • Ensure all guests follow venue rules and established safety protocols
  • Respond to emergency situations including but not limited to safety hazards, fights, medical emergencies, and threats to life and/or property
  • Communicate with venue management, staff, and law enforcement as needed
  • Enforce company policies and standard operating procedures
  • Conduct briefings with security team members at the start of each shift
  • Monitor surveillance systems and identify potential security concerns
  • De-escalate conflicts professionally and efficiently
  • Assist with the training and development of security officers on site

What Qualities Are We Looking For?

  • Minimum 3 years of security experience, preferably in nightlife, hospitality, or event settings
  • Valid Illinois PERC Card (Permanent Employee Registration Card) required
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to write clear, detailed incident and accident reports
  • Must be available to work Thursday through Saturday, 2nd and 3rd shifts (2:00 PM – 4:00 AM)
  • Ability to stand or be on feet for periods of up to 6 to 8 hours
  • Strong organizational, time management, and problem solving skills
  • Ability to remain calm and professional under high pressure situations
  • Ability to work cohesively with other departments and co-workers as part of a team
  • Must pass a background check

Join us to be part of a dynamic team committed to safety excellence! We value proactive leadership, attention to detail, and a passion for creating secure yet lively entertainment experiences. If you’re ready to make a difference in Chicago’s vibrant nightlife scene, we want to hear from you!

Equal Opportunity Employer

AG Security Group Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

Pay: $21.00 per hour

Benefits:

  • 401(k)
  • Health insurance
  • Paid time off

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: FLSD/Security Officer (Hotel) - PM/Overnight (Temporary)
jobs.description:
Security Officer

The Security Officer is responsible for the safety and security of all our guests, employees, and visitors of the hotel. They are responsible for protection of all hotel assets, ensuring that hotel security policies and procedures in accordance with Sonesta Hotels International corporate guidelines are enforced and that the hotel is in full compliance to all local, state, and federal regulations. The Security officer also performs hotel security functions, to include fire prevention, safety, investigation, and resolution of guest and employee complaints regarding safety and security matters.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Deliver on the promise of Sonesta Service in all interactions with guests and clients. Manage according to the Sonesta G.U.E.S.T. standards and instill a passion for customer service in all associates of the hotel.
  • Performs normal hotel security functions to include fire prevention and safety checks.
  • Investigates thefts, accidents, and other incidents which occur on the property.
  • Prevents losses of company and guests property due to thefts, burglary, pilferage, and other criminal activity.
  • Ensures a safe and tranquil environment for guests and employees.
  • Assists guests and colleagues on all security and safety related enquiries.
  • Resolves guest and employee complaints regarding safety and security matters.
  • Conducts floor patrols during tour of duty, including checking of doors, windows, and securing facilities during non-operating hours.
  • Monitors the activities of personnel on the premises to detect and counter thefts and other criminal activities.
  • Completes associates forms and reports related to any accidents or issues within the premises of the hotel.
  • Immediately reports hotel deficiencies to appropriate departments for immediate repair.
  • To perform other work related duties as assigned by Management.

QUALIFICATIONS AND REQUIREMENTS:

  • Regular and punctual attendance.
  • Ability to adhere to the propertys grooming standards.
  • Ability to stand and walk on a continuous basis, and run as warranted.
  • Ability to safely operate a motor vehicle during all hours and in all weather conditions.
  • Ability to understand and execute all safety and emergency procedures, (for example: fire, crowd control, inclement weather, and bomb threats.)
  • Ability to understand and operate emergency equipment, (for example fire extinguishers, wheel chairs, respirators.)
  • Ability to lift, carries, and store in overhead areas approximately 50 lbs.
  • Ability to lift and move, in an emergency situation, an immobilized adult.
  • Ability to bend, squat, kneel, climb (including stairs and ladder), and reach.
  • Ability to push and/or pull approximately 75 lbs.
  • Ability to work in extreme temperature.
  • Ability to utilize communication equipment (for example: telephones, radios, and beepers.)
  • Ability to communicate clearly and effectively with guests and other employees.
  • Ability to interact with guests and other employees in a courteous, empathetic, and discreet manner.
  • Ability to read and write effectively.
  • Ability to sustain direct contact with the public; must establish high degree of customer service, (smile, eye contact, positive personal presentation, etc.), and high volume interaction with guests and staff.
  • Will be required to work mornings, evening, weekends, and holidays.

Additional Job Information/Anticipated:

Pay Range: $31.05 - $41.40 Pay rate outlined follows contract requirements.

Benefits:

  • Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance
  • Health Savings Account with Company Match
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan with Company Match
  • Paid Vacation and Sick Days
  • Sonesta Hotel Discounts
  • Educational Assistance
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Company Paid Life Insurance
  • Company Paid Short Term and Long Term Disability Insurance
  • Various Employee Perks and Discounts
  • Hospital Indemnity
  • Critical Illness Insurance
  • Accident Insurance

Sonesta is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

Upon submitting your application, please ensure you complete a full application in addition to attaching a resume. Incomplete applications received will not be considered.
